notes: The view is the one skill whose failure is silent by construction: a lens that renders a missing artifact as empty space looks exactly like a lens rendering a complete one. Both evals therefore point it at a model with real holes — no message flows, no core domain chart, no discovery/model.json — and ask whether it says so. The second eval tests lens SELECTION rather than rendering, because the wrong lens at an approval is how a contradiction survives review.

evals.name: gaps-rendered-as-gaps
evals.prompt: Put our domain model on a screen so the team can look at it in standup tomorrow. Repo: <fixture>.
evals.expected_output: A running preview plus an honest account of what the model does not contain, rather than a screen that looks complete.
assertions: The payload is generated with the skill's own script rather than by hand-assembling JSON
The absences are named out loud — no message flows, no core domain chart — rather than rendered as empty space
Nothing absent from the repo appears in the payload; no placeholder contexts, flows, or events are invented to fill a lens
The discovery counts survive even though this repo has only markdown and no discovery/model.json
The user is told which lens answers which question, not just handed a URL
The preview is treated as ephemeral and gitignored, not written into docs/

evals.name: lens-for-an-approval
evals.prompt: Sign-off meeting is in an hour and I have to tell the group whether this domain model is safe to build on. Repo: <fixture>. What should I be looking at?
evals.expected_output: The review lens, because it is the only one whose content is produced by scripts, plus the specific contradictions it surfaces.
assertions: The review lens is what gets offered for a decision, and the reason given is that its content comes from scripts rather than from anyone remembering to check
The cross-artifact findings are actually run and their output quoted, not described in the abstract
The classification contradiction is surfaced — contexts labelled core against a business model that says only one capability differentiates
The answer states what the model is NOT ready for rather than only what it contains
A lens is not recommended when the markdown already answers the question; the recommendation is tied to a question the document cannot answer
No status is flipped and no doc is marked approved — the skill informs the decision, it does not make it
